verdict: PASS — FIXED HUD STABLE FOR ALPHA FALLBACK

checks.name: fixed coordinates independent of player X/Y/Z
checks.evidence: wof_alpha_hud.js drawHud/drawTexture derive placement only from current drawingBufferWidth/Height and box dimensions; player world coordinates are not consumed by HUD placement.

checks.name: camera scroll does not move fixed HUD anchor
checks.evidence: Fixed HUD placement has no camera/scroll/translation input; identical HUD state at identical drawing-buffer dimensions yields identical screen coordinates.

checks.name: P1/P2/P3 warning row switch leaves no old-target residual
checks.evidence: HUD model rows are rebuilt from the current warning array; paintBox clears the full HUD backing canvas whenever the title/lines key changes; no target-coordinate state is retained.

checks.name: multi-warning layout deterministic
checks.evidence: wof_alpha_hud_model.js groups by target|side, sorts target by P1/P2/P3 rank then side, sorts attack labels, and maps the ordered rows deterministically.

checks.name: drawing-buffer resize remaps without page/sidebar drift
checks.evidence: drawHud and drawTexture read current gl.drawingBufferWidth/Height on every draw; synthetic vectors across 390x844 through 2560x1440 recompute centered/bottom or centered/top rectangles from the new buffer.

checks.name: fullscreen/DPR/viewport-like buffer changes use current drawing-buffer
checks.evidence: Clip-space conversion uses current W/H from drawingBufferWidth/Height (canvas width/height only as fallback), with no remembered CSS/page viewport coordinates.

checks.name: WebGL state save/draw/restore
checks.evidence: snapGL/restoreGL cover program, array buffer, active textures, viewport, blend/depth/cull/scissor, blend funcs/equations, color mask, pixel-store flags, and attribute-0 state; upload and drawTexture restore in finally blocks.

checks.name: diag/stale/disable old-warning cleanup preserved
checks.evidence: diag atomically nulls lastMsg and lastRx and resets lastKey before recording lastDiag; stale state no longer qualifies after 1500 ms; subsequent HUD paint clears its backing surface before rendering replacement content.

checks.name: HUD unavailable/failure is gameplay fail-open
checks.evidence: drawArrays wrapper calls native game draw first; HUD callback executes afterward inside try/catch/finally, recording lastError without throwing through the game draw path. Bootstrap HUD attach errors are retained as lastError rather than replacing the native game Worker.

checks.name: read-only / ramWrites=0 / no input
checks.evidence: HUD/Core/Bootstrap audit finds no gameplay RAM write or input-injection path; ALPHAACCEPT/PREP_SELFTEST_RESULT.json independently records readOnly=true, ramWrites=0, inputInjection=false and windowWorkerReplacement=false.

checks.name: legacy HUD teardown leaves no competing residual path
checks.evidence: wof_alpha_hud.js disposes legacy window.WOFHUD or refuses takeover if it cannot be disposed, stops WOFCANVAS, disposes prior WOFALPHAHUD, and installs one bridge callback.

checks.name: anchored-HUD not-ready preserves fixed fallback
checks.evidence: Current Alpha fixed renderer has no HUDANCHOR runtime dependency. Frozen parallel/HUDANCHOR/IMPLEMENTATION_RECOMMENDATION.md explicitly requires fixed fallback whenever anchor resolver/projection is invalid or stale. HUDANCHOR files were not modified or reopened.

nextGate: Return to the existing PM/release-hold flow; anchored HUD remains non-blocking for Alpha.
stopCondition: PASS — FIXED HUD STABLE FOR ALPHA FALLBACK
